headline: Iron Ore Falls to Two-Year Low on Weak Demand Outlook
summary: Iron ore prices dropped 1.2% to $89.40 per ton in Singapore trading, reaching a two-year low. The decline reflects weakening demand prospects from major steelmaking markets.
why: Iron ore is a primary raw material used in steel production and serves as a major driver for global bulk shipping and mining sentiment.

impacts.name: Steel Industry
impacts.why: Softening demand for industrial metals weighs on iron ore commodity prices.

why_moved: Weak demand expectations from global industrial manufacturers drove iron ore prices down to two-year lows.
